),

WITH c AS (
  SELECT provider_type, SUM(complaints) AS complaints
  FROM complaints_daily
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM opened_date) = 2025
  GROUP BY provider_type
),
t AS (
  SELECT provider_type, SUM(trips) AS trips
  FROM trips_daily
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM service_date) = 2025
  GROUP BY provider_type
),
j AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(c.provider_type, t.provider_type) AS provider_type,
         c.complaints,
         t.trips
  FROM c
  FULL OUTER JOIN t ON c.provider_type = t.provider_type
)
SELECT provider_type,
       complaints,
       trips,
       ROUND(1000.0 * complaints / trips, 1) AS complaints_per_1000_trips
FROM j
UNION ALL
SELECT 'All providers',
       SUM(complaints),
       SUM(trips),
       ROUND(1000.0 * SUM(complaints) / SUM(trips), 1)
FROM j
ORDER BY provider_type
notes: Assumes "last year" means calendar 2025 (today is 2026-11-23), complaints and trips are matched by provider_type only (complaints_daily has no borough, and trips_daily is summed across boroughs), and the rate is total complaints per 1,000 total trips.

WITH c AS (
  SELECT provider_type, SUM(complaints) AS complaints
  FROM complaints_daily
  WHERE opened_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND opened_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY provider_type
),

  SELECT provider_type, SUM(trips) AS trips
  FROM trips_daily
  WHERE service_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND service_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY provider_type
),
by_provider AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(c.provider_type, t.provider_type) AS provider,
         c.complaints,
         t.trips
  FROM c FULL OUTER JOIN t ON c.provider_type = t.provider_type
),

  SELECT 'All providers' AS provider,
         SUM(complaints) AS complaints,
         SUM(trips) AS trips
  FROM by_provider
)

       complaints,
       trips,
       ROUND(1000.0 * complaints / trips, 1) AS complaints_per_1000_trips
FROM (SELECT * FROM by_provider UNION ALL SELECT * FROM overall)
ORDER BY provider;
